project.title: Collaboratory Creative Coding Jam
project.description: A hands-on workshop on real-time visual programming for newcomers, closing with a collective live jam.
project.introText: A Hydra Video Synth workshop I proposed and led in the HDSC2024 open program of Hackers & Designers, at Het Wilde Weg in Amsterdam on 20 July 2024.

gridImages.caption: The workshop page on the Hackers & Designers site.

project.middleText: Hydra is an open-source, browser-based live coding tool by Olivia Jack, inspired by modular synths. After an introduction to its primitives, textures and commands, up to fifteen participants made visuals from scratch, remixed video and live streams, and closed the afternoon with a collective live jam.
project.context: HDSC2024 open program, Hackers & Designers, Het Wilde Weg, Amsterdam

summary.brief: An open workshop in the Hackers & Designers summer program.
summary.method: An introduction to Hydra's primitives, textures and commands, then a collective live jam.
summary.outcome: A three-hour workshop and jam at Het Wilde Weg, Amsterdam, on 20 July 2024.

project.shows: Teaching as opening the tools up: newcomers writing and performing real-time visuals in one afternoon.

decisions.choice: Start from Hydra’s primitives, then close with a collective live jam.
decisions.why: Most participants were new to live coding; a few building blocks were enough to start making visuals.
decisions.result: Up to fifteen newcomers made visuals from scratch and performed together the same afternoon.
